Pousada Guajir Kite Safari accommodation
Accommodation at Pousada Guajir Kite Safari
Ilha do Guajirú
Famous for it's giant, massive Lagoon
aka the 'Flatwatersea'
-->
At Guajiru's tented Kite Safari you'll enjoy both comfort and charm, along with the serenity and silence of the ecological paradise of Ilha do Guajir . It's beachfront located at Praia da Tartaruga, under the palmtrees .
Reduced prices if you book before end of may!!!
You'll be staying in comfortable Sahara tents covered by thatched roofs , all equiped with electricity and internet connection. There are various models of tents available and there's a common building with sanitation facilities, showers, a kitchen and a bar.
F.Y.I. the water is even pumped up by our famous winds and is purified after use! Plus, we produce our own electricity with wind and solar energy!!! Ecotourism all the way...
Our location is ideal for relaxing, but also as a starting point for kitesurfing or other watersports . Furthermore it's an excellent spot for exploring the natural wonders of an ecological paradise . Learn more about ecotourism on Guajir
We stand for simplicity and natural ambience, like campfires and preparing your own food at your private BBQ!
Still, if you stay with us breakfast is included anyway. And if you don't want any hassle about food, we'll be happy to prepare you lunch and dinner for a reasonable price. Take a look at our prices
We arrange airport pick ups! If booked in advance, we will arrange to have our driver pick you up and bring you directly to Ilha do Guajir and pousada Guajir Kite Safari.
PRICES and BOOK NOW
CONTACT US
Guajir Kite Safari Photo Gallery
NO OTHER wind- or kitesurf SPOT worldwide has ever given such hard GUARANTEES and posesses such TOP WIND statistics as Ilha do Guajir !
Between June and January the guarantee stands for EVERYDAY WIND!
From February until May the guarantee stands for MIN. 50% WIND!
A WIND DAY is registered when the wind blows:
min. 12 knots or more!
min. 1.5 hours or more!
between 06.00 and 18.00 hrs!
Ilha do Guajiru, the world's windiest spot, ALL YEAR ROUND...

Ilha do Guajirú, the Flatwatersea | Brasil
Ilha do Guajirú, the Flatwatersea
Ilha do Guajirú
Famous for it's giant, massive Lagoon
aka the 'Flatwatersea'
Ilha do Guajirú is located in the northeast of Brasil, in the state of Ceará, near to Fortaleza. It is mostly famous for it’s giant, massive Lagoon . Due to the perfect direction of wind and water, the Main Lagoon is called the FLATWATERSEA . There is hardly water available anywhere worldwide, that is flatter while at the same time of this size. The lagoon is more then 4 kilometers long and up to 400 meter wide!
With the Dunes in the front and Praia da Barra at the back, the Main Lagoon offers an absolute safe harbour for every kind of watersporter. You will find direct access to the Main Lagoon directly from Praia da Barra, Praia do Guajirú, Praia das Dunas and the Secret Spot. These spots, regardless of low tide, always offer wonderfull rides!
How to get there
More Highlights of Ilha do Guajirú
Enjoys an average of approximately 3000 hours sun every year!
Has an ideal climate, being located almost at the equator!
Reaches temperatures average between 26 & 32 degrees Celcius everyday!
Has no lack of water at any time, due to the massive Lagoon in the front and a River circling at the back!
If you love Eco Tourism, wildlife and nature, Ilha do Guajirú is a great place to visit!
More about eco tourism
There is a wealth of different places to explore and discover around Ilha do Guajirú.

pages.title: Kiteboarding at Ilha do Guajirú, the Flatwatersea, Brazil
pages.text:
Kiteboarding at Ilha do Guajir , the Flatwatersea, Brazil
Kitesurfing at Ilha do Guajir : the Flatwatersea
Ilha do Guajirú
Famous for it's giant, massive Lagoon
aka the 'Flatwatersea'
-->
The huge Main Lagoon of Ilha do Guaji , measuring 4000 x 400 meters , is appreciated for it's massive, superflat water and is often nicknamed "THE FLATWATERSEA". Moreover there are very good winds, making it an ideal place for kitesurfing.
The Guajir Kite Safari pousada is close to the "Secret Spot" . At the Secret Spot (and Praia do Guajir ) where the Lagoon meets the ocean, you'll find butter flat water and perfect waves in one place!
You'll only find white, sandy beach with no rocks or obstacles anywhere , allowing you easy, comfortable and safe access into the Lagoon s crystal clear turquoise blue waters!
There's wind EVERYDAY! Mostly from 15 to 25 knots, side shore and completely steady - a wish of both beginners and advanced kiteboarders!
What kite to bring? Most of the time, depending on your weight, you will end up using a 7 or a 10 m kite.
Don't want to bring your own kite? No problem, you can rent them over here.
For newbies and beginners there are 4 kiteschools on Ilha do Guajir . Lessons can be taught 1-to-1 or in small groups.
